chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Pray six cycles of prayer in the Masjid of Mina at the base of the minaret.
ai.seo_question: How many cycles of prayer should be performed in the Masjid of Mina according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a specific Sunnah prayer of six rak'at at the base of the minaret (sawm'ah) in Masjid al-Mina, emphasizing the spiritual merit of performing voluntary prayers at the site of the Hajj rituals. In Shia jurisprudence, this is often cited alongside the general recommendation to shorten prayers during travel, yet it underscores the distinct virtue of dedicating specific acts of worship to the sacred geography of Mina. The location 'as-sawm'ah' refers to the corner or base of the minaret, marking a focal point for pilgrims to connect with the prophetic tradition of worship in this holy valley.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Pray six Cycles in Masjid of Mina at the base of the minaret’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn abu Hamzah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Perform six Rak‘at Salat (prayer) in Masjid of Mina’ in the original al-Sawma‘ah (the structure near the minaret). (Fatwa explains h 4-5 above)
